address: Bockenheimer Landstraße 31, Frankfurt on the Main, 60325, Germany
bio: Housed in a villa dating from 1925, this restaurant is chic, almost opulent – the wonderfully lively atmosphere is complemented by friendly, attentive and adept service. To the side is Raw Bar, and there is an open kitchen. The menu features French cuisine, including oysters, lobster cocktail, offal dishes and high-quality barbecued steak. Good, exclusive wine selection....
